hints.title: Character Index Buckets
hints.text: Maintain 26 separate index collections, one for each lowercase English letter.

hints.title: Star Resolution
hints.text: When encountering a star, identify the smallest character that has at least one active index, and remove its most recent occurrence.

hints.title: Marking Removals
hints.text: Mark removed character indices in a boolean array or set, then reconstruct the final string skipping marked positions and stars.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Iterating across 26 stacks for each star takes constant 26 operations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning preceding substring on each star takes O(n^2) resulting in TLE.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory for stacks and removal flags.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use 26 LIFO stacks to greedily remove the rightmost smallest character in O(26) time.
